title: Trilogy Physics past-paper question viewer

sign_in.rule: enabled true requires a non-empty classes list of REAL class names as the school writes them. The assembler refuses otherwise. An invented list splits one cohort across two spellings and the teacher tracker cannot rejoin them; the Trilogy seat writes cohorts in the form '27 Trilogy 11Q'.

publication_ruling.rule: The IB Maths ruling (d014/q12) does not inherit. AQA content needs its own ruling from Smith before anything is pushed. The assembler will build a bundle without it; the staging tool will not write into the deployment checkout.
